'''Mike Schuff''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 Milwaukee tournament]] on 29 April 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court]] and Speeder Ops, according to Ryan Fojtik's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d671">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-05-milwaukee-wi-4-29-00d671/ milwaukee-wi-4-29-00], DeckTech (Ryan "XjedeyeX" Fojtik, 5 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-05-milwaukee-wi-4-29-00d671/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
